contract.task: Build a frozen repository-grounded quality workload for a real-model text/token/KV comparison: 12 deterministic cases and a strict JSON scorer, without making model calls.
context: Worktree /Users/alexey.zhuchkov/.codex/worktrees/agent-language-concept/Agents, frozen HEAD7b81e3e8b748f7cfff0c6b712740ff313bd5f091. Read experiments/accord/ir.py, runtime.py, src/engine/subagent_validation.py and relevant docs for snippets.
Parent is starting real Qwen3 8B via llama.cpp; do not call inference or server endpoints. Same full rendered messages and greedy decoding will be used for all representations/cache states.

Quality means bounded correctness on repository tasks, not broad agent capability. Favor meaningful boundary/trace/code diagnosis with simple objective short outputs. Avoid requiring private source/state absent from prompt. Workload must be frozen before model run; no posthoc correction to improve model score.
scope: Read relevant worktree sources; write workload module/JSON/result and tiny tests only under /private/tmp; run pure deterministic tests.
non_goals: No worktree edits, inference, network, installs, Git mutation, secret access, further delegation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Write /private/tmp/accord-inference-workload.py and /private/tmp/accord-inference-workload.json; JSON includes frozen common context, 12 named cases with question/expected/category/source evidence, base commit and source hashes.

Use current Accord source for 4 contract/diagnostic retrieval cases, 4 execution-state reasoning cases and 4 bounded code/edit reasoning cases. Answers must fit one JSON object with answer key and be exactly machine-checkable; avoid ambiguous questions or executing generated code.

Keep common context <=18000 UTF8 bytes and cases <=600 characters. Include necessary source excerpts for every answer; no evaluation answer leak into context. Model should return JSON only, maximum128 generated tokens.

Scorer accepts only a single JSON object with exact key/type/value; do not recover arbitrary prose or coerce Boolean/numeric values. Include tiny self-tests for correct/wrong/malformed outputs, run them and record results.
Save exact required worker result JSON to /private/tmp/accord-inference-workload-result.json.

limitations: This workload measures bounded repository correctness across 12 cases, not broad agent capability. No model or server calls were made.
The runner must enforce the recorded 128-token generation limit and disable model reasoning; the scorer validates response shape/type/value, not tokenizer-specific output length.
Expected answers were established from the frozen source; no generated code or stateful runtime/model callbacks were executed.
